title.en: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE HOLDING OF HORSE RACES IN THE CITY OF MANILA ON FEBRUARY SECOND, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND EIGHT, DESIGNATING ANOTHER DATE THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
title.orig: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE HOLDING OF HORSE RACES IN THE CITY OF MANILA ON FEBRUARY SECOND, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND EIGHT, DESIGNATING ANOTHER DATE THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01807_1908_html.txt

text.en:
No horse races shall be held in the city of Manila substitute day, on February second, nineteen
hundred and eight. In lieu thereof, horse races may be held in the said city on February ninth, nineteen
hundred and eight, anything in Act Numbered Fifteen hundred and thirty-seven, as amended, to the contrary
notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 1, 1908.
